text.en:
26th. MARCH, 2008 No. S 40

CORRIGENDUM FINANCE COMPANIES ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2006 (S 4112006) In the English text of this Order, published in No. 23 of Part II of the Government Gazette dated 15th. March, 2006, the correction is made at page 788, in section 16 in the third line, the number "43" should read as "44". I . • '
